package student_test

import (
	"context"
	_ "embed"
	"encoding/json"
	studenthttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/student"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

//go:embed testdata/student-next-action-owner.json
var actualOwnerSnapshots []byte

type nextOwnerTransport func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)

func (f nextOwnerTransport) RoundTrip(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) { return f(r) }
func TestNextActionConsumesActualNativeOwnerSnapshots(t *testing.T) {
	var fixture struct {
		Snapshots []json.RawMessage `json:"snapshots"`
	}
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(actualOwnerSnapshots, &fixture))
	require.Len(t, fixture.Snapshots, 8)
	for _, snapshot := range fixture.Snapshots {
		client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: "http://owner.test", LearningWorkspaceToken: "synthetic", HTTPClient: &http.Client{Transport: nextOwnerTransport(func(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
			return &http.Response{StatusCode: 200, Header: http.Header{"Content-Type": []string{"application/json"}}, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(string(snapshot))), Request: r}, nil
		})}}
		action, err := client.GetNextAction(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
		require.NoError(t, err)
		output, err := json.Marshal(action)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.JSONEq(t, string(snapshot), string(output))
	}
}
